name: Papyrus
description: A privacy-first, offline-first PDF & EPUB reader. Your books stay on your device.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'; connect-src 'self' blob: data:; img-src 'self' blob: data:; font-src 'self' blob: data:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; frame-src 'self' blob: data:;
